Landing.title: WeeklyFeedback
Landing.tagline: The weekly report your team no longer has to write, and you no longer have to summarize.
Landing.description: Every week we ask each person on your team three short things — what they did, what they'll do next, whether they're blocked — over Telegram or email. We turn the answers into a single narrative report, ready to read in 30 seconds.
Landing.trustNote: 30 days free · Cancel anytime · Data in the EU
Landing.proofTitle: Built for teams who already have enough on their plate
Landing.proofDesc: No generic templates, no extra app to install. That simple.
Landing.proof1Desc: Stored in Supabase, on European servers. Never shared or sold.
Landing.proof2Desc: A real narrative summary, not a filled-in template — ready in 30 seconds.
Landing.proof3Desc: Your team replies over Telegram or email, wherever they already are. No accounts to create.
Landing.proof4Desc: Cancel anytime from your dashboard. No fine print, no cancellation call.
Landing.howItWorksDesc: Three steps, zero friction for your team.
Landing.step1: Set up your team and choose the reminder day/time.
Landing.step2: Each person replies once a week, on the channel they already use.
Landing.step3: You get a single report, grouped by project, with blockers and priorities.
Landing.sampleTitle: Here's what your report looks like
Landing.sampleDesc: Generated automatically from that week's replies — nobody has to write a thing.
Landing.sampleWin1: Ana wrapped up the checkout redesign, ready for QA.
Landing.sampleWin2: Bruno migrated the CI pipeline, builds went from 12 to 4 minutes.
Landing.sampleBlocker1: Carla needs access to the staging environment, requested 3 days ago.
Landing.sampleNext2: Bruno looks into the bug support flagged.
Landing.pricingDesc: One price per team, not per seat.
Landing.planOrgDesc: Up to 5 teams, optional executive summary.
Landing.priceNote: Prices exclude VAT. 30 days free with card, no commitment.
Landing.faq1Q: Does my team need to install anything?
Landing.faq1A: No. They reply over Telegram or email, channels they already use. Nobody creates an account or logs into any dashboard.
Landing.faq2Q: What happens to my team's data?
Landing.faq2A: It's stored in Supabase, on servers in the European Union. We never share or sell it to third parties.
Landing.faq3Q: Do I need a card to try it?
Landing.faq3A: Yes, but you won't be charged for the first 30 days. Cancel before then and you pay nothing.
Landing.faq4Q: Can I change plans or cancel anytime?
Landing.faq4A: Yes, no commitment. You do it yourself from your dashboard, anytime.
Landing.faq5A: Yes, the interface and reports are generated in native Spanish — or English, if you prefer.
Landing.finalCtaTitle: Start getting your team's report this week
Landing.finalCtaDesc: 30 days free with card. Cancel anytime.
Landing.footerTagline: Your team's weekly report, without anyone having to write it.
